summary: Testing of AgentApex features #21 (Property Edit FAB + Notes) and #24 (Radius filtering in map search) completed. All 10 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: FAB button, bottom sheet with 4 options, Notes section, radius badge, radius slider, radius circle on map. Fixed 2 backend bugs during testing.

fixed_during_testing.fix: Created PropertyUpdate model with all optional fields for partial updates

fixed_during_testing.issue: GET /api/agentapex/properties with radius filter crashed on properties with null lat/lng
fixed_during_testing.fix: Added null check before haversine calculation

fixed_during_testing.issue: Property response model had required latitude/longitude fields causing 500 errors
fixed_during_testing.fix: Made latitude/longitude optional in Property model, added notes and youtube_videos fields

Bottom sheet opens with 4 options: Gallery, Document, Notes, Video - all with data-testid attributes
Notes section shows note count, Add Note button, and note cards with delete functionality
Add Note drawer has textarea (data-testid='note-textarea') and Save button (data-testid='save-note-btn')
Property ID (AX-P-xxxxx) displayed in PropertyEdit header
MapSearch radius badge shows 'X km radius | N found' format
Filter drawer has radius slider (1-50km) with quick-select buttons (5, 10, 20, 50 km)
Radius circle drawn on map with dashed orange line
Property cards in grid view show property_id badges

test_credentials.otp: Dynamic - shown on screen as 'Demo OTP: XXXXXX'

seed_data_creation: Test properties created and cleaned up during backend tests
